0x000BEE.en:
An isolated South Pacific island off the Marquesas, where the meteorite Meteor 3 fell in New Era 179. The <EOTI Organization> set up headquarters there to study it, and the <EOT> and anti-alien weapons research there became the power base of the <DC>.
It was fortified in the name of <EOT> secrecy, with defenses built on air power. Largely destroyed in the <L5 Campaign>, it was later rebuilt by the GS as its base, 'Grand Christmas.'

0x0018E9.en: Extra Over Technology Inquiry Organization. Founded in New Era 180 to analyze the <EOT> found in 'Meteor 3,' the mysterious meteorite that fell on Aidoneus Island. Brilliant scientists gathered from around the world under Bian Zoldark, hailed as the genius of his age. It became the parent body of the <DC>, where its scientists continued developing weapons and systems.

0x00276D.en: The upheaval caused by the Inspectors in New Era 187-188. They were aliens from another star system, auditing Earth's civilization, who judged that humanity's insatiable fighting spirit would disturb galactic order and schemed to control the Earth Sphere. Invading in 187, they blitzed the Moon and North America, but the mass Einst outbreak forced them off Earth, and the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom annihilated them.

0x0032C5.en: AMN stands for Armored Module Network: a system that rapidly relays combat data between <Armored Module>s and shares it across units. The former <EOTI Organization> and <DC> pursued its development, but slow mutual data exchange kept it from adoption.

0x003A04.en: Short for Mass Amplitude Preemptivestrike Weapon: a weapon for mass wide-area first strikes. MAPWs divide by area of effect into straight-line, circular, and impact-scatter types. Also called 'map weapons.'

0x004925.en:
Formed in New Era 184, when ten space colonies united as an independent nation, by reorganizing the Earth Federation space forces stationed there. Nominally separate, it is effectively under Federation Army control (which some officers resent). Its demanding space combat role means its personnel are highly skilled.
In late New Era 186 it declared war on the Federation alongside the DC. Holding most spaceborne forces of the day, it quickly seized control of space, then supported DC ground operations. After commander Maier V. Branstein fell in battle it surrendered - in truth to prepare for the coming alien war, and many of its units joined 'Operation SRW,' the L5 Campaign's final operation.
Postwar its leaders were replaced and its name became a formality, but it still makes up most of Earth's space forces.

0x005D26.en:
A humanoid-weapon pilot training institution that once existed in the Federation Army, founded alongside the <Aggressors>. It first retrained conventional pilots for machines like the <Personal Trooper>, but its aim changed completely once Adler Koch took charge.
Rather than convert veterans, Adler sought pilots raised from the start for humanoid weapons. He secretly gathered children with no family and superior reflexes and dynamic vision, and had Dr. Agilla Setme of the Japan Special Neuromedical Research Institute erase and alter their memories. Through conditioning, drugs, and special training he tried to swiftly create humans specialized in piloting and combat: the 'Boosted Children.' They were sorted into metal-named classes - Aurum (gold), Argent (silver), Bronzo (bronze), Hierro (iron), Latooni (brass) - and adjusted for various roles.
Perhaps due to these forced methods, only a handful excelled. The inhumane program and its poor results became a scandal and the School was dissolved, but the Boosted Children's training continued under the <DC>.

0x006BD2.en: A barrier projected from the Tower of Harmony over all of <La Gias>, supplying mana worldwide and limiting large-scale magic.

0x0071E3.en: An uprising by the <DC> from late New Era 186 into 187. Rebelling against the Earth Federation, it seized bases across the Earth Sphere in a blitz using <Armored Module>s, but leader Bian Zoldark died in the Hagane's raid on Aidoneus Island; the DC fell into chaos and lost to the Federation Army.

0x0083BF.en: An over-technology research institute in Colorado, North America, founded in New Era 171 by Bian Zoldark. Its famed alumni include robotics authorities Jonathan Kazahara and Erik Wan. Though most members left when the <EOTI Organization> was founded, it continues independent <EOT> research, <Tesla Drive> improvements, and Grungust-series development. Its name derives from inventor Nikola Tesla and scientist Wilhelm Reich. Jonathan Kazahara is its current director.

0x008C88.en: A substance discovered in Meteor 3. It does not occur naturally in the Solar System and was found sealed in clearly artificial containers. Each piece is a rice-grain-sized metal holding enormous energy. Six existed in Meteor 3 and were analyzed by the <EOTI Organization>; some were provided to the Federation Army through deals involving Major Ingram Prisken of the SRX Project. The Tronium Engine extracts this virtually inexhaustible energy as motive power; its energy conversion per unit time is immeasurable. As materials at Earth's technological level cannot withstand the high energy produced, limiters are installed. Raising output also accelerates energy generation, making output control extremely difficult.

0x00A571.en:
A spherical super-large space fortress used by the <Aerogaters> as their base in the <L5 Campaign>. Formally the "Automated Planet Neviim"; "White Star" was Earth's codename. With mobile weapon plants, a spaceport, a 1G housing block with simulated weather, and multiple farms, it is virtually a mobile colony. One theory says it was to carry warlike humans back to the Aerogater homeworld, but this is unproven.
Crippled late in the L5 Campaign by the Operation SRW allied fleet's assault, it passed to Earth Federation Army control. In New Era 187 the invading <Inspectors> seized it as their base. It later fused with Neue Regisseur, leader of the <Einst>, becoming the giant weapon Stern Regisseur, and vanished after a fierce battle with the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom in another dimension.

0x00B16C.en: I<Elemental> machines bound to high spirits; they choose their own operators. Built by Langran to counter threats to all of <La Gias>. Four exist, guarded by Wind, Flame, Water, and Earth.

0x00B9BD.en: Short for 'Re-Mind Control.' Originally, per-mission memory adjustment and mental control of subjects under memory manipulation or suggestion, such as the <Boosted Children>. Excessive rewriting risks mental collapse, and implanting alien concepts is also dangerous, so related data is normally rewritten gradually. <Boosted Children> keyed by emotions - love, friendship, hostility, grudges - easily exceed their specs.
